item.title: Former CSS & UWS Baseball Coach Eddy Morgan Named Manager for Brewers Class A Affiliate
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- St. Scholastica baseball alum Eddy Morgan has been named the manager of the Brewers Class A affiliate, the Wilson Warbirds. Morgan graduated from CSS in 1998 and was later an assistant coach for the program. He also had a stop in Superior, where he coached the Yellowjackets for seven seasons. item.title: Board of Regents Approves Contract Extension for UMD Director of Athletics Forrest Karr
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- UMD Director of Athletics Forrest Karr has received a new contract extension. On Thursday, The University of Minnesota Board of Regents approved the extension that goes through June of 2032. Karr has served as the Bulldogs Director of Athletics since August of 2022. During his tenure, 11 of the 16 varsity programs have participated in NCAA postseason competition....
